title: proof-check-policy/v1
description: Configuration for one Proof Check evaluation. Canonicalized and digested like the receipt (JCS-style canonical JSON, SHA-256 over canonical bytes). Declared-scope entry grammar, adopted verbatim from prior art proven in production CI: one entry per line under a single '## Allowlist' markdown section when the source is a PR body (exactly one such section; zero or duplicates fail CLOSED); each entry is an exact repository-relative path, an fnmatch glob, or a directory prefix ending in '/**'. Fail-closed grammar refusals: bare '*' or '**'; a leading '/'; '..' path traversal; an empty prefix before '/**'; any entry broad enough to swallow the universal improbable probe path (checked at runtime). No section, an empty section, or an out-of-list path all fail CLOSED. Author-controlled declarations remain advisory even when frozen and hashed.

scopeEntry.description: Exact path, fnmatch glob, or '<prefix>/**'. Rejects bare '*' and '**', leading '/', and '..' segments. The universal-swallow refusal is enforced at runtime, not here.

source.description: pr_body_allowlist reads the PR body '## Allowlist' section; file:<repo-relative path> reads a manifest from the trusted base; pinned:<sha256> requires the declaration bytes to match this digest.

trust.description: author_pr_body is advisory at most; blocking requires a trusted_base_manifest or owner_pinned_input source.

entries.description: Inline alternative to the source, same grammar.

required_selectors.description: Exact check names or app-id selectors.

policy.description: V0: observation only, no review rule.

indeterminate_exit.description: Default 20. An opt-out to 0 must be explicit here and is logged in the receipt; it is never a default.
